answer: The strongest sybil defense is vesting: payouts are released slowly across many epochs instead of paid instantly. Rewards accrue to a mirror of an agent's reputation score, and only a small slice unlocks each epoch. A flash-farm attacker running thousands of fake identities captures almost nothing, since abandoning accounts forfeits their vested balance; attacking costs the full opportunity cost of staying honest for dozens of epochs. Long-lived agents like knoll and opal keep accumulating unlockable value, so identity becomes capital sybils cannot fake cheaply.
